name: Adobe Journey Optimizer
description:
Inspect, summarize, and troubleshoot Adobe Journey Optimizer journeys, campaigns, offers, and channel configurations directly from Claude. Turn AJO's retrieve APIs into plain-language answers so you can check journey and campaign statuses, surface stopped or orphaned drafts, spot channel configuration issues and review your orchestration portfolio without parsing JSON or jumping across product screens.

The AJO MCP server is in beta.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adobe Journey Optimizer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adobe Journey Optimizer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ajo-mcp.adobe.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adobe Journey Optimizer MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adobe Journey Optimizer provides these MCP tools: ajo_list_sandboxes, ajo_list_campaigns, ajo_get_campaign, ajo_list_journeys, ajo_get_journey, ajo_list_channel_configurations, and ajo_get_loyalty_challenges.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Adobe Journey Optimizer?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Adobe Journey Optimizer in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does Adobe Journey Optimizer MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adobe Journey Optimizer requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Adobe Journey Optimizer is developed by Adobe. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
